AssetClass.description:
Asset class categories affected by a stress template.

These values describe the primary risk buckets touched by a historical
scenario so registries can expose coarse filtering and search.

DateWire.description: ISO 8601 calendar date encoded as a `YYYY-MM-DD` JSON string.

TemplateSeverity.description:
Severity classification for stress scenarios.

This label is intended for discovery and filtering rather than for pricing
logic. Registries and UIs can use it to group historical events by the
magnitude of the modeled dislocation.

oneOf.description: Mild stress with limited market dislocation.
Moderate stress with broader but contained market impact.
Severe systemic stress with large cross-asset dislocations.

description: Descriptive metadata of a built-in scenario template.

examples.description: Lehman Brothers collapse and ensuing global credit crisis. Severe flight-to-quality in rates, massive credit spread widening, equity crash, and volatility spike. Market-data identifiers in this template (e.g. USD-SOFR, USD-IG, SPX_VOL) are modern placeholders, not historical instruments; override them via ScenarioSpecBuilder::override_curve to match your market data.
examples.name: Global Financial Crisis 2008

asset_classes.description: Asset classes materially affected by the scenario.

components.description:
IDs of composable sub-component templates.

Empty when the template is atomic rather than a composite built from
multiple reusable scenario fragments.

description.description: Description of the historical event and modeled effects.

event_date.description:
Primary date associated with the historical event.

This is typically the date of the market dislocation rather than the
valuation date used when the template is later executed.

tags.description: Freeform tags used for filtering and discovery.

title: TemplateMetadata
